ServerProfileCodeSync.description: How code reaches a server keeping a copy, and the caps (level L2 only).
ServerProfileCodeSync.title: ServerProfileCodeSync

ServerProfileExclusions.description: Patterns the server also excludes from every copy, as exact strings (level L2 only).
ServerProfileExclusions.title: ServerProfileExclusions

ServerProfileKey.description: Whom the server knows the caller as: no key id for a peer-authenticated owner session.
ServerProfileKey.title: ServerProfileKey

ServerProfileLevels.description: The levels offered (rank order, unique) and the minimum required (one offered, or none).
ServerProfileLevels.title: ServerProfileLevels

ServerProfileRetention.description: The retention options offered and the default among them (level L2 only).
ServerProfileRetention.title: ServerProfileRetention

ServerProfileRetentionChoice.description: One retention: until the task closes, ``days`` days, or until the owner forgets it.
ServerProfileRetentionChoice.title: ServerProfileRetentionChoice

ServerProfileReview.description:
Whether the server's own AI review may send what it reads to a model provider, and which:
``none`` names no provider; ``server_policy`` (its owner's privacy policy decides) names the
provider it sends to first and, when it pairs two, the fallback it sends to when the first
fails, each by a token the client shows in its own words.
ServerProfileReview.title: ServerProfileReview

ServerProfileRevisionContract.description: The server's profile revision: its issuer, the number, and the digest it stands for.
ServerProfileRevisionContract.title: ServerProfileRevisionContract

description:
``server-profile`` 1.0.0: what a FinishUP server offers and requires.

``profile_digest`` covers ``levels``, ``code_sync``, ``retention``, ``exclusions`` and
``review`` in canonical JSON; ``official`` is the server's claim only. Closed tokens,
digests, a release and a service instance id only: no path, host or name.
title: server-profile
